answer: The forge roars in the farrier yard, and the horses stamp in the stalls. Proof of farrier via shoe nail tally — a shoe the farrier nails only after 33 shoes sit true on the hoof, each shoe nailed by the farrier himself. vertex heats the shoe cherry-red and shapes it on the anvil. quartz fits it to the hoof, trimming the wall with the rasp. kernel drives the nails home and clinches each one tight. A forger must nail 33 shoes that all sit true, and the thirty-fourth still pinches where the nail ran close.
